plans.idea: Product-left banner: the sneaker anchors the left third at full height, then one left-aligned column on the right reads logo → large two-to-three-line headline → badge row (Set a Reminder first) → legal, all on one shared left edge.

Message-first: the brand and headline lead from the left edge with the action badges right under them, and a large sneaker fills the right side with the legal set quietly beneath it, so the banner reads left to right from message to product.

Three-panel triptych: the logo sits as a vertically centred brand block on the far left, a central column stacks the headline, badge row and legal, and the sneaker closes the right panel, which gives an even, symmetric spread of weight across the 4:1 strip.
